en.html:
Sorimachi"!!"
Sayo"Stay exactly as you are. Otherwise I shall split your spine."
Sorimachi"...The old attendant... Arre, you came out safely?"
Sayo"For these old bones, a winter swim was rather too much hospitality. Since then, the shivering has refused to leave."
Sayo"And when my hand may slip, who knows...? So control yourself very carefully. No suspicious movements, please."
Sorimachi"...Kheh..."
Sorimachi"HYEH!!"

en.html:
Sorimachi"Ghh... hih..."
Sayo"...You are throwing your life away. Surely devotion to Lieutenant Colonel Cannon was not bringing you to this extent?"
Sayo"And that flying wonder-tamasha machine. An interesting tsurugi, certainly. Pity about what is inside—"
Sayo"Most are ordinary amateurs, no? Drugs raise the reactions and physical ability, and lo, instant warriors. Is that not the arrangement?"
Sorimachi"............"
Sayo"Against Muramasa, they do not qualify."
Sorimachi"...Heh, heh. Yes..."
Sorimachi"That is how it would be... yes."
Sayo"...?"
Sorimachi"That bastard winning... I wanted to see it... with my own eyes..."
Sorimachi"Hiheh... heheheh. Hyehheheheheheheheheh."
Sorimachi"Heh.............................."

ja.html:
雪車町「ぐっ……ひ……」
さよ「……犬死をなさる。 　キャノン中佐に命懸けの忠義を捧げていた わけでもありますまい」
さよ「お空の上の、愉快痛快ビックリマシンも。 　面白い騎体である事は認めますが、惜しむ らくは中身――」
さよ「あの大半は単なる素人でございましょう？ 　薬物投与で反応速度と運動能力を引き上げ られただけの俄か武者……違いますかな」
雪車町「…………」
さよ「村正どのの敵とはなり得ませぬ」
雪車町「……へ、へ。 　そう……」
雪車町「そうでしょう……ねェ」
さよ「……？」
雪車町「野郎の勝つところ…… 　……見てやりたかったぜぇ……」
雪車町「ヒヘ……ヘヘ……。 　ヒェッヘヘヘヘヘヘヘヘ」
雪車町「へ……………………………………」
